reuse.why: Calls the shared assertBankAccountNotLinked, link.findOrCreateBank, handleSyncResponse and reuses the Akahu balance branch in processBankSyncDownload, but the link and download flows are written out again rather than shared.

duplication.why: linkFintegraAccount (~75 lines) is a near-verbatim copy of the Akahu/PluggyAI link functions and downloadFintegraTransactions a verbatim copy of downloadAkahuTransactions, adding a sixth copy of each block.

placement.why: Each piece sits where the other providers' equivalents live (server-config, SYNC_PROVIDERS, types/models, accounts/app.ts, accounts/sync.ts).

scope.why: Only what the new provider needs, plus tests.

maintainability.why: Consistent with the existing per-provider pattern and easy to read, but any fix to the link or download flow now needs one more identical edit.
